login.subtitle: Sign in to your Sonalis server
login.errorUnreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the address and that this iPhone is on the same network.
login.errorServerTooOld: This server is too old for the app. Update Sonalis on the server.

home.empty: Play something and it will show up here.

library.guestBody: Sign in with a Jellyfin account to browse the library. As a guest you can search and request songs.

detail.notInLibraryHint: None of these songs are in your library yet. Tap one for a preview.
detail.ownedOf: {{owned}} of {{total}} songs are in your library.
detail.downloadedOnly: Only the songs downloaded to this iPhone

track.removeFromPlaylistFailed: Could not remove the song from the playlist
track.playlistNotYours: You can only edit your own playlists

search.hint: Search the catalog and request songs for your library.

offline.title: Downloads
offline.empty: Downloaded songs play without the server. Use the download button on an album, playlist, or song.
offline.downloadsOnly: Offline mode: only the songs downloaded on this iPhone.

settings.removeAllConfirm: Remove every downloaded song from this iPhone?
settings.offlineBanner: Server unreachable. Downloaded songs still play.
settings.preferencesFooter: Saved to your account: the web app uses the same settings.
settings.preferencesPending: Saved on this iPhone. Sent to your account, and to the web app, when the server is reachable again.
settings.serverFooter: The address this iPhone uses to reach Sonalis. Change it to switch between your home network, a VPN, or a domain.
settings.serverChangeBody: Another address of the same Sonalis server. You stay signed in.
settings.serverOtherBody: Your account is not signed in on that server. Sign in there?
settings.jellyfinFooter: Server settings for everyone, the same as in the web app. Changes apply after Save.
settings.musicDirOk: The music folder exists on the server.
settings.musicDirMissing: The music folder does not exist on the server.
settings.urlInvalid: Start the address with http:// or https://
settings.aliasesFooter: A former or alternate artist name (as Deezer shows it) mapped to the name in your library. Tap an alias to remove it.
settings.aliasFromBody: The name as Deezer shows it.
settings.storageFooter: Songs downloaded to this iPhone, in the Files app under On My iPhone.

errors.alias_same_name: An alias cannot be the same as the library name.

settings.signingFooter: Apps signed with a free Apple ID stop opening after 7 days. Install the app again with Impactor or refresh it in SideStore before then: login and downloads are kept.
settings.lyricsUsersFooter: Lets every Jellyfin account edit synced lyrics, in the web app and in the app beta. Administrators always can.
settings.betaLyricsFooter: Adds Edit lyrics to the player menu. Still in testing: check the result in the player after saving.

errors.offlineBody: The Sonalis server is unreachable. Your downloaded songs are in the Downloads tab.

queue.actionFailed: The server could not be reached.

shortcuts.unknown: This action needs a newer version of Sonalis.
shortcuts.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in the app.
shortcuts.noSong: Say the name of a song.
shortcuts.noDownloads: There are no downloaded songs on this iPhone.
shortcuts.emptyLibrary: The library has no songs yet.
shortcuts.offlineDownloads: The server cannot be reached, so only the downloaded songs play.
shortcuts.alreadyHere: Music is already playing on this iPhone.
shortcuts.movedHere: Moving the playback from {{device}} to this iPhone.

shortcuts.requested: Requested {{title}} by {{artist}}. The server is downloading it.
shortcuts.queueEmpty: The server is not downloading anything.

shortcuts.downloadingCollection_other: Downloading {{count}} songs of {{name}} to this iPhone.

updates.title: Update Sonalis
updates.available: Sonalis {{version}} is available. Update now? Your sign-in and downloads stay.
updates.footer: Updates install through SideStore, which needs LocalDevVPN. With the switch on, Update runs the shortcut "{{update}}" (connect LocalDevVPN, then open the Shortcut Input as a URL), and the next time you open Sonalis it runs "{{vpn}}" (connect your usual VPN, such as Tailscale).
updates.vpnHint: Turn on LocalDevVPN, then install the update in SideStore.
updates.noSideStore: SideStore is not installed on this iPhone.
updates.noShortcuts: The Shortcuts app could not be opened.

playlistPicker.failed: The playlist could not be changed.
playlistPicker.notInLibraryYet: The song is not in the library yet. Try again in a minute.
